# Get Involved

Awesome ESM is built by and for the community. We welcome contributions of all kinds!

---

## Why Contribute?

By contributing, you help:
- **Researchers** discover new papers and use cases
- **Developers** find code examples and best practices
- **Everyone** build better understanding of protein language models

---

## Ways to Contribute

### 📝 Add a Paper

Found a great paper using ESM models? Help us build our collection!

**What to include:**
- Paper title and link
- Brief summary (2-3 sentences)
- Which ESM model(s) were used
- How ESM was used (technique/application)
- Your name and affiliation

[**📝 Add a paper**](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=add-paper.md){.btn .btn-primary}

---

### 💡 Share a Use Case

Have you built something interesting with ESM? Tell us about it!

**What to include:**
- Title of your project/analysis
- Brief description
- ESM model(s) used
- Key results or findings
- Code/notebooks if you'd like to share
- Your contact info

[**💡 Share a use case**](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=add-use-case.md){.btn .btn-primary}

---

### ❓ Suggest an FAQ Entry

Is something confusing? Help us improve documentation!

**What to include:**
- Your question (in plain language)
- Suggested answer
- Code example (if applicable)
- Links to relevant resources

[**❓ Suggest FAQ entry**](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=add-faq.md){.btn .btn-primary}

---

### 📺 Request or Contribute a Tutorial

Want to see a tutorial on a specific topic?

**To request:**
[📺 Request a tutorial](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=tutorial-request.md){.btn .btn-secondary}

**To contribute:**
- Create a Jupyter notebook or script
- Include clear documentation
- Test your code thoroughly
- Submit a pull request

[📤 Contribute a tutorial](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md){.btn .btn-secondary}

---

### 🐛 Report Issues

Found a typo, broken link, or error?

[**🐛 Report an issue**](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=bug-report.md){.btn .btn-secondary}

---

### 💻 Improve the Site

Want to contribute code, design, or documentation improvements?

**Get started:**
1. Fork the [repository](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm)
2. Create a branch for your changes
3. Submit a pull request

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for detailed guidelines.

[**💻 View guidelines**](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md){.btn .btn-secondary}

---

## Contribution Guidelines

### Be Respectful

- Be kind and welcoming to all contributors
- Assume good intent
- Respect others' perspectives

### Keep It Accurate

- Link to original sources
- Include proper citations
- Verify information before submitting

### Keep It Relevant

- Contributions should relate to ESM models or protein language models
- No spam or promotional content
- Focus on quality over quantity

### Lightweight Curation

We review contributions to ensure they're:
- ✅ Relevant to ESM
- ✅ Accurate and well-sourced
- ✅ Not spam or duplicates

We don't review for scientific merit—just quality and relevance.

---

## Recognition

Contributors are recognized in:
- Pull request comments (GitHub)
- Paper table contributor column
- Monthly contributor highlights (coming soon)

### GitHub

- **[Discussions](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/discussions)** - General discussion, ideas, feedback
- **[Pull Requests](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/pulls)** - Submit code contributions

### Slack

- **[Join the Biohub Slack](https://biohub.slack.com)** for real-time discussion and community

### Email

- **[resources@biohub.ai](mailto:resources@biohub.ai)** for questions or suggestions
